value.title: Non vedere è differente dall'assenza
value.synopsis: As Taishakuten recovers from his wounds, an enraged Fudo vows to hunt Ashura down. When Fudo goes AWOL, Amida and Bonten must locate him.

value.title: Riconciliati con gli amorali
value.synopsis: The deities have earned a break after their fierce battle against Mara. Ashura tries to integrate with the team, but can he successfully do so after all that’s happened?
